Messages.Author: xcver
Messages.Body:
Hi,

is Keystone Kine considered a necromancy action (for Tower of London
for example)? And if yes only when necromancy has been used for it, or
even if the acting minion doesn't use the necromancy effect?

Greets,

Bernd

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:


IANLSJ, but i would think that it does count as necromancy action
when, and only when, the nec level is used

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. An anarch with Celerity and Obfuscate but with no Necromancy could play
it at [cel]+[obf] (or at [cel] or at [obf]), so clearly playing it at
[cel]+[obf] doesn't require Necromancy, so it is not an "action requiring
Necromancy".
